set.body:
Source: 2026-08-03 full-codebase review (quality/design/efficiency/correctness).

Problem:
JobObservation.reportedCluster was added by the cluster-attribution work (P8.A1,
P8.D4) and is populated by the CLI parser and asserted by ClusterAttributionSuite,
but the hand-written agent codec in protocol/AgentDomainJson.scala omitted it on
both the encode and decode side. Because the field carries a default of None the
decoder compiled cleanly under -Werror, so every observation crossing the SSH
boundary silently lost cluster attribution. Only the local path retained it,
which is why the existing suite passed.

This is the failure mode P6f.12 names: a hand-written codec whose field set is not
pinned by a law or a fixture drifts from its case class without any signal.

Acceptance:
- Encode and decode reportedCluster on JobObservation.
- Emit conditionally, so an observation without a cluster keeps its prior wire
  shape and observation-timing-v1.json stays byte-identical.
- Absence decodes to None, so a peer predating the field still decodes and no
  protocol major is required.
- Round-trip test demonstrated RED against the parent commit.
set.title: P8.A7: Carry reportedCluster across the observation wire
